Screen studies by title and abstract with an LLM

Source: R/assessment.R
df_assess_batch.Rd

For each identifier: gets metadata (from the cache, or fetched and cached), fills the project's assessment prompt, asks the LLM for a structured decision following _assessment_schema.yml, validates it, and caches the result together with its provenance (model, token use, cost and a fingerprint of the prompt, schema and criteria).

Usage

df_assess_batch(
  chat,
  identifiers,
  metawoRld_path = ".",
  mode = c("parallel", "sequential", "batch"),
  force = FALSE,
  force_fetch = FALSE,
  max_active = 10,
  batch_file = NULL,
  wait = TRUE,
  email = Sys.getenv("DATAFINDR_EMAIL"),
  api_key = Sys.getenv("NCBI_API_KEY")
)

df_assess_relevance(chat, identifier, metawoRld_path = ".", ...)

Arguments

chat

An ellmer chat object, e.g. ellmer::chat_openai(model = "gpt-4.1-mini"), or a "provider/model" string for ellmer::chat().

identifiers

Character vector of DOIs/PMIDs.

metawoRld_path

Project root.

mode

"parallel" (default; many requests at once), "sequential" (one by one), or "batch" (the provider's batch API: about half the price, but results can take up to 24 hours; supported by OpenAI, Anthropic and Google Gemini).

force

Re-assess even if a current cached result exists.

force_fetch

Re-fetch metadata even if cached.

max_active

Maximum simultaneous requests in parallel mode.

batch_file

File used to track a batch job (mode "batch"). Re-run the same call to resume. Defaults to a file in the cache folder.

wait

In batch mode, wait for the results? If FALSE and the batch is not finished, the function returns early; call it again later.

email, api_key

Passed to df_fetch_metadata().

identifier

A single DOI/PMID.

...

Further arguments passed to df_assess_batch().

Value

A tibble with one row per identifier: identifier, status ("assessed", "cached", "failed" or "pending"), decision, score, rationale, exclusion_reason, error, input_tokens, output_tokens and cost.

df_assess_relevance(): the assessment as a list (decision, score, rationale, ...), or an error.

Details

Cached results are reused unless they were produced with a different prompt, schema, criteria or model (then they are redone), or force = TRUE. Manual decisions (e.g. saved from df_shiny_assess()) are never overwritten unless force = TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
chat <- ellmer::chat_openai(model = "gpt-4.1-mini")
hits <- df_search_pubmed("biomarker X AND pregnancy", "my_review")
res <- df_assess_batch(chat, hits$identifier, "my_review")
table(res$decision)
} # }
